title: Facebook Comment Scraper input
description: Free Apify Facebook comments scraper — no login or cookies. Works with public Pages, profiles, Groups, and single post URLs.

pageOrUrl.title: Page, profile, group, or post URL
pageOrUrl.description: Public Facebook Page handle (e.g. facebook / ronaldo), user profile handle or numeric id, full Group URL (https://www.facebook.com/groups/...), or a single post/permalink URL. Private or login-gated targets will fail. If a handle returns 0 posts, try the numeric id or change residential proxy country (see README troubleshooting).

maxPosts.title: Max posts
maxPosts.description: Maximum recent posts to scrape from a Page, profile, or Group feed (ignored for a single post URL). Each post's comments are paginated in full, so runtime and proxy cost scale with how many comments the posts have — raise this once you have seen what one post costs on your target.

profile.title: Policy profile
profile.description: default = 3 workers + reply cap 1500 (best quality/time); tops_only = no replies; full_replies = always fetch replies (not recommended).

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: async = streaming httpx (recommended on Apify); threads = requests thread pool.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify residential proxy (on by default). Main reliability lever. If runs return 0 posts for a public target, set proxy country to match the audience (or your country) and retry — wrong exits often get empty feeds.

workers.title: Workers (advanced)
workers.description: Override the worker count from the profile.

replyFbCap.title: Reply cap (advanced)
replyFbCap.description: Fetch replies only when a post's FB comment_count is below this. 0 = tops only.

minIntervalSec.title: Min interval seconds (advanced)
minIntervalSec.description: Pause between comment pages, per worker. Higher = gentler on rate limits.

megaThreshold.title: Mega threshold (advanced)
megaThreshold.description: If set, pin the single heaviest post to a dedicated worker.
